cart_id: UUID v4 used to correlate frontend cart/checkout when known
shopware_entity_id: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; HTTP uses this only for sales_channel_id
money: non-negative exact decimal string, up to 4 fraction digits
currency: ISO 4217 uppercase 3-letter code in monetary payloads only
payment_method: stable technical key, not a display/translated label
sku: same product key as Shopware product_number
event_id_version: UUID v4 only; UUID v7 is invalid
